findings_fixed.trigger: Persistence fails after publishing extension metadata or assignment changes, including an overlapping profile write.
findings_fixed.fix: Fresh assignment Sets and shared publication provenance restore the last valid state without overwriting independent newer publications. Extension mutations use a serial lane.

findings_fixed.trigger: A later engine-state write fails after extension deletion has already reached SQLite.
findings_fixed.fix: Authoritative extension replacement, assignment changes and profile state now share the engine-state SQLite transaction.
validation: real SQLite failure after deletion preserves extension and assignments
successful deletion removes both durable and live state

findings_fixed.trigger: Global toggle exceeds the public 1000-profile batch limit, an empty fleet is globally enabled, or reload derives a new id and loses store metadata.
findings_fixed.fix: Dedicated global toggle snapshots the fleet inside its mutation lane and persists future-profile defaults. Reload preserves stable ids and metadata; reload-all reads at most four files concurrently and publishes once. Built-in removal protection remains sticky when re-adding the folder.
validation: 1201-profile fixture, one save
empty-fleet global enable inherited by first profile
no-op assignment skips persistence
multiple-extension reload uses one save
legacy stable id and store metadata retained
built-in protection cannot be downgraded

findings_fixed.trigger: Rapid toggles interleave browser stop/start operations, or one browser fails to stop or restart.
findings_fixed.fix: IPC mutations serialize across assignment and restart. Bounded stop/start workers use numeric cursors. Responses include failures and skipped ids; the UI warns on partial application.
validation: concurrent on/off requests
at most four stops and three starts
explicit stop failure, blocked stop and skipped restart responses

findings_fixed.trigger: Profile reads or saves, account secrets, file reads or extension assignment replies arrive after reopening or switching the editor/dialog.
findings_fixed.fix: Editor and assignment session tokens plus request generations suppress stale updates. Extension refreshes share a single request lane and trailing refresh. Preference acknowledgements update only their own control.
validation: real Chromium late profile read and save
same account selected in a newer session
late file read after editor mode switch
old assignment reply preserves reopened same-extension dialog
refresh concurrency one with latest visible version
out-of-order preference replies preserve both controls

findings_fixed.trigger: JSON/TXT imports bypass CSV row caps, Unicode text exceeds byte limits, or explicit page_size=0 is accepted for an empty fleet.
findings_fixed.fix: Shared import helpers reject files over 16 MiB before reading and validate actual UTF-8 bytes. JSON/TXT imports cap profiles at 5000. Explicit empty credential aliases remain empty. API rejects explicit zero page sizes.
validation: oversized file rejected before file.text
multibyte UTF-8 limit
real Chromium JSON and TXT 5001-row rejection
API pagination boundary

findings_fixed.trigger: A newer cache edit arrives while the previous save is in flight, or caller-owned nested settings are mutated before persistence.
findings_fixed.fix: Clone submitted nested settings, await the disk barrier, and return an independent durable snapshot. Client-settings IPC responds with that snapshot.
validation: first acknowledgement reports persisted 81 while later 82 is pending
caller and acknowledgement objects cannot mutate the cache
20 consecutive edits coalesce into exactly one file replacement
reload/write race, retry and quit flush regressions
